title: Translation invariance under V and growth O(Rⁿ) force dim V ≤ n
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, ν a Borel measure on ℝ^P, V ⊆ ℝ^P a linear subspace and C ∈ [0, ∞) (C : ℝ≥0∞, C ≠ ∞). Assume ν({x : v + x ∈ A}) = ν(A) for every v ∈ V and every Borel A ⊆ ℝ^P, ν(B_R(0)) ≤ C·Rⁿ for every R > 0, and ν(B_1(0)) > 0 (open balls). Then dim V ≤ n.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (ν : Measure (Euclid P)) (V : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (C : ℝ≥0∞), C ≠ ∞ → (∀ v ∈ V, ∀ A : Set (Euclid P), MeasurableSet A → ν ((fun x => v + x) ⁻¹' A) = ν A) → (∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ν (ball 0 R) ≤ C * ENNReal.ofReal (R ^ n)) → 0 < ν (ball 0 1) → Module.finrank ℝ V ≤ n
